attribution: Both exact proof attempts contain a real parsed Lean apply-unification error at 63:2 and a separate retained compiler-stderr memory-panic report. Describing these observations as solely a tactic rejection omits the resource report.

The failure code and blocking severity are what the frozen checker emitted. run_build routes failed candidate-proof compilations to CANDIDATE_BUILD_FAILURE using the default blocking severity; it does not inspect stderr for resource-specific classification.
The parsed Lean error alone makes CompileResult.ok false in the frozen code. No successful proof, completed kernel replay, or task refinement follows from either failed check.

When parsed errors already exist, compile_named_module does not append its nonzero-exit fallback. SandboxResult has argv and returncode, but CompileResult discards them; failure diagnostics also omit wall_seconds and isolation. Neither check retains exit code, termination signal, peak RSS, resource-cause code, or merged stdout/stderr chronology.

The exact resource boundary that produced the memory-panic report is undetermined. These records do not prove host exhaustion, an OS OOM kill, exhaustion of Lean -M, or exhaustion of RLIMIT_AS; nor do they prove the tactic error was caused by memory exhaustion.
The compact repair inventory enumerates errors[] and keeps stderr in the referenced full artifact. For these records the panic is not a separate numbered compact error entry.
authority: Independent retained-evidence and generic-code diagnosis only; no task outcome or infrastructure-status authority.
